cgr.sourceNote: Built from bf986bd with Cargo.toml version bumped to 0.2.0; engine source is identical to tag v0.2.0.

method.fullIndex: 1 untimed warmup + 3 timed CLI rebuilds per side in alternating order; wall time via monotonic clock, peak RSS via /usr/bin/time -l
method.fullIndexAuto: Separate 1 warmup + 3 timed cgr index runs with CGR_THREADS unset (auto on 10 cores)
method.sync: 3 timed sync commands per category (noop, comment edit, alternating single-file rename) and side in alternating order; original bytes restored and synced after each category with full graph-restoration, status --verify --strict, and debug diff verification
method.warmQuery: 8 warm-up queries, then 20 fixed queries x 3 passes in-process (60 observations); nearest-rank percentiles
method.cliQuery: New-process CLI explore of the first query, 3 runs per side in alternating order
method.graphKey: (source natural key, target natural key, kind, line, UTF-16 column) where natural key = (file_path, kind, name, start_line, start_col); precision = shared/cgr, recall = shared/upstream
method.answerSize: upstream outputChars are UTF-16 code units, cgr outputChars are UTF-8 bytes
